hook: 埋 means bury: you dig a hole, put something in, and fill it up again.
老 is old, as in 老人 (old person): 老い is old age itself.
恐 means fear: see the heart (心) at the bottom, shaking with fear.
From 恐 (fear): something that fills you with fear is 恐ろしい, terrible.
昼 is daytime, noon: お昼 is noon, and the meal you eat then, lunch.
Change (改) toward good (善): making something better, improvement.
Turn back (回) and return (復) to how you were: recovery.
替 means swap, as in 両替 (money exchange): you swap one thing for another.
House (家) + tools (具): the tools that fill a house, furniture.
語 is word, language (as in 日本語): 語る is to put words together and tell.
Feel (感) + emotion (情): your feelings.
Your heart (心) is connected (関) to something: you are interested in it.
Feel (感) + think (想): what you felt and thought, your impressions.
Air (気) + season (候): the air through the seasons, climate.
Wish (希) + hope, look far (望): looking far ahead with a wish, hope.
Rest (休) + free time (暇): time off to rest, a holiday.
Tool (器) + use (用): good at using tools, handy.
Offer (供) + give (給): offering and giving what people need, supply.
Giant (巨) + big (大): very, very big, huge.
悔 has the heart radical (忄) and means regret: your heart burns, so frustrating.
苦 means suffering, bitter: it is painful and hard.
Scene (景) + air, mood (気): the mood of the market, business conditions.
Lacking (欠) + point (点): a point where something is missing, a weakness.
Appear (現) + real (実): what really appears in front of you, reality.
Power (権) + benefit (利): the power to get a benefit, your right.
Lecture (講) + perform (演): performing a lecture, a talk.
Combine (合) + measure (計): add it all up, the total.
越 means go over: you cross over a mountain or a line.
Country (国) + meeting (会): the nation's meeting, parliament.
Sit (座) + seat (席): a place to sit.
Bewitch (魅) + power (力): the power to charm people.
結 has the thread radical (糸): tie threads together, to tie or link.
Wool, hair (毛) + cloth (布): a woollen cloth, a blanket.
訳 has the words radical (言): turn words into another language, translate.
Sun (陽) + spirit (気): a sunny spirit, cheerful, or sunny weather.
Use (用) your heart and mind (心): be careful.
Extra (余) + plenty (裕): having room to spare.
Cool (冷) + quiet (静): staying cool and quiet, calm.
Link (連) + thought (想): one thought linked to another, association.
Talk (話) + title (題): the title of a talk, the topic.
Bad (悪) + mouth (口): bad words from your mouth, insults.
Mind (意) + ground (地): a mind that stands its ground, stubborn spirit.
Joy (歓) + voice (声): voices full of joy, cheers.
Choose (選) + pick (択): choosing, a choice.
Noisy (騒) + sound (音): noise.
Handle (操) + make (作): handling a machine to make it work, operation.
Equip (装) + put (置): equipment put in place, a device.
Value (尊) + respect (敬): looking up to someone, respect.
Big (大) + messenger (使): a country's big messenger, ambassador.
Great (大) + minister (臣): a cabinet minister.
From 高い (high): 高める is to make something higher, to raise.
助 means help (as in 助ける): 助かる is to be helped or saved.
Stand (立) + place (場): the place where you stand, your position.
Single (単) + pure (純): just one pure thing, simple.
単 means single, simple: 単なる means just a simple, mere thing.
Land (地) + area (域): an area of land, a region.
Near (近) + time (頃): times near now, lately.
Middle (中) + centre (央): the very centre.
Long (長) + period (期): a long period.
Go out (出) + meet (会う): you go out and meet someone by chance.
Fixed (定) + period (期): a fixed period, regular.
Came out (出来) + thing (事): something that came about, an event.
Go through (徹) + night (夜): going through the whole night without sleep.
Sky (天) + season (候): what the sky is doing, the weather.
Pass on (伝) + line, unite (統): customs passed down a line, tradition.
Answer (答) + draft (案): your written answers, an exam paper.
Arrive (到) + reach (着): arrival.
Way (道) + road (路): a road.
閉 is a gate (門) with a bar inside: shut it, close.
届 means deliver, reach: like a letter that reaches you.
流 has the water radical (氵): water flows.
Day (日) + always, usual (常): every day, ordinary life.
Sun (日) + light (光): sunlight.
Farming (農) + people (民): farmers.
Ability (能) + power (力): what you are able to do.
残 means remain, left over: 残す is to leave something behind.
上 is up: 上る is to go up, climb.
Both 俳 and 優 can mean actor: a performer on stage.
Horse (馬) + deer (鹿): someone who can't tell a horse from a deer is a fool.
Bring out (発) + see (見): seeing something new for the first time, discovery.
Send out (発) + go (行): sending a magazine out into the world, to issue it.
Start out (発) + spread out (展): growing and spreading, development.
No (否) + decide (定): deciding no, denial.
Show (表) + appear (現): making what is inside appear, expression.
Surface (表) + face (面): the outside face, the surface.
Not (不) + OK, can (可): not OK, not allowed.
Dance (舞) + platform (台): the platform where people dance, a stage.
Pair (双) + child (子): a pair of children, twins.
Visit (訪) + ask (問): visiting someone to ask, a call.
Protect (保) + proof (証): proof that protects you, a guarantee.
任 means duty, entrust: hand your duty to someone else.
Life (生) + edge (涯): life up to its very edge, your whole lifetime.
Search (捜) + inspect (査): the police search, investigation.
Create (創) + make (造): making something new, creation.
Cure (治) + heal (療): medical treatment.
Fall over (倒) + property (産): the company's property falls over, bankruptcy.
Same (同) + person, samurai (士): people of the same kind, comrades.
敗 means defeat: 3勝2敗 is three wins, two losses.
Show (表) + show (示): showing it clearly, display.
煙 has the fire radical (火): what rises from fire, smoke.
Woman (女) + few (少): something rare, so strange or unusual.
刑 has the knife radical (刂): a punishment, a sentence.
縄 has the thread radical (糸): threads twisted together into a rope.
膝 has the flesh radical (月): the body part that bends, your knee.
Bamboo (竹) on top: a bamboo pipe, a flute or whistle.
隊 is a group moving together, as in 軍隊 (army): a party or troops.
福 has the altar radical (礻): a blessing from the gods, good fortune.
Mouth (口) on the left: words passed mouth to mouth, a rumour.
柄 has the tree radical (木): the wooden handle of a tool or sword.
丘 looks like a little hill with two bumps: a hill.
型 has earth (土) at the bottom: a clay mould that gives things their shape.
Same kanji as え (handle): がら is the pattern on cloth, or a person's build.
霧 has rain (雨) on top: wet air, fog or mist.
県 is a prefecture, like 千葉県: Japan has 47 of them.
Rice (米) + divide (分): rice divided into tiny bits, flour or powder.
損 has the hand radical (扌): money slips out of your hand, a loss.
唯 means only: ただ is just, merely, only this.
Same kanji 唯 (only): たった is a stronger only, like たった一人 (just one person).
偶 means couple or even number, and also chance (偶然): たまに means once in a while.
僧 has the person radical (亻): a person who serves at a temple, a monk.
観 means look, view (as in 観光): 人生観 is your view of life.
Left (左) + right (右): left and right, and pushing things either way, influence.
更 means again, renew: 更に adds even more on top, furthermore.
Support (支) + give (給): money given out to support you, an allowance.
Funds, materials (資) + source (源): the source of materials, resources.
従 means follow: you follow the rules, obey.
Real (実) + do (行): really doing it, putting it into practice.
Older sister (姉) + younger sister (妹): sisters.
Heavy (重) + look at (視): looking at something as heavy, important.
Heavy (重) + big (大): heavy and big, serious.
Head (首) + minister (相): the head minister, Prime Minister.
Go out (出) + place (場): going out onto the field to take part.
Come out (出) + body (身): where your body came out from, your hometown.
順 means order: wait in order for your turn.
Order (順) + number (番): your number in the line, your turn.
Encourage (奨) + study (学) + money (金): money to encourage study, a scholarship.
Always, usual (常) + knowledge (識): what everyone usually knows, common sense.
Trade (商) + sell (売): trading and selling, business.
Prize (賞) + goods (品): the goods you win, a prize.
Job (職) + work, business (業): your occupation.
Eat (食) + table (卓): the table you eat at, the dining table.
Plant (植) + thing (物): a planted thing, a plant.
Eat (食) + desire (欲): the desire to eat, appetite.
Woman (女) + child (子): a girl or woman.
Woman (女) + actor (優): an actress.
Deal with (処) + reason, logic (理): dealing with things in order, processing.
Close, parent (親) + relatives (戚): the people close to your family, relatives.
Person (人) + kind, type (類): the human kind, mankind.
救 means rescue (as in 救急車, ambulance): to save someone.
既 means already, finished: 既に is already.
Correct (正) + style, ceremony (式): the correct way, official.
Live (生) + thing (物): a living thing.
Stone (石) + oil (油): oil from rock, petroleum.
Set up (設) + plan, measure (計): measuring and planning a building, design.
遭 has the road radical (辶): you run into trouble, like 事故に遭う (have an accident).
Grip (握) + hand (手): gripping hands, a handshake.
預 means deposit, entrust: someone leaves a thing with you, and you keep it.
温 means warm (as in 温泉, hot spring): to warm something up.
当 means hit, right on: the arrow hits the target.
現 means appear (as in 現れる): to show, to reveal.
勢 has power (力) at the bottom: force, momentum.
Mind (意) + think (思): what your mind wants to do, your intention.
Different (異) + usual (常): different from usual, abnormal.
One (一) + layer (層): one more layer on top, even more.
One (一) + bring to (致): brought together into one, agreement.
Shift (移) + move (動): moving from place to place.
Be, stay (居) + sleep (眠り): sleeping right where you sit, dozing.
疑 means doubt (as in 疑問, question): to doubt.
映 has the sun radical (日), as in 映画 (movie): light projects an image.
映 as in 映画 (movie): an image shows up, to be reflected.
From 売る (sell): 売れる is to be sold, to sell well.
Flourish (栄) + nourish (養): what makes your body flourish, nutrition.
得 means gain, profit (as in 得意): える is to get.
Same 得 (gain) as える: うる is the older form, heard in あり得る (can happen).
Perform (演) + skill (技): performing skill, acting.
Aid (援) + help (助): giving help, support.
Perform (演) + explain (説): explaining in front of people, a speech.
追 has the road radical (辶): run down the road after someone, chase.
King (王) + child (子): the king's child, a prince.
From 終わる (end): 終える is to finish something.
Words (辞) + ceremony (儀): a polite greeting ceremony, a bow.
Dirty (汚) + dye (染): dirt dyes the water, pollution.
互 means mutual: お互い is each other.
Like an adult (大人): calm, quiet and well behaved.
下 means down: おろす is to bring something down, to lower it.
恩 has heart (心) at the bottom: the debt your heart feels for a kindness.
Picture (絵) + painting (画): a painting.
Pleasant (快) + suitable (適): pleasant and just right.
飼 has the food radical (食): you feed an animal, to keep a pet.
Certain (確) + real (実): certain and real, sure.
Study (学) + learn, practise (習): studying, learning.
Fire (火) + disaster (災): a fire disaster.
賢 has shell, money (貝) at the bottom: a wise person guards their treasure, clever.
堅 has earth (土) at the bottom: hard as packed earth.
方 is a polite word for person: 方々 is people (polite).
Lively (活) + energy (気): lively energy.
Music (楽) + tool (器): a music tool, an instrument.
Study (学) + period (期): a study period, a school term.
Space (間) + separate (隔): the space separating two things, interval.
Look (観) + check (察): watching and checking carefully, observation.
